[[File:Teapot_TCW.png|thumb|right|220px|Whorm Loathsom's teapot]]
A '''teapot''' was a vessel used for serving [[Tea/Legends|tea]].<ref name="Crystal Star" /> 

==History==
After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] dear friend and fellow [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Tahl]], Jinn's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] brewed [[sapir tea]] early every [[Local day/Legends|morning]] during their stay in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] as a way to console him. As [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] tasked them with a new mission, Kenobi was just coming in with a tray containing a small teapot and a steaming cup of sapir tea.<ref name="SOTJ">[[Secrets of the Jedi (novel)|''Secrets of the Jedi'']]</ref>

During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] met with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]] under the pretense of surrendering. When Kenobi requested refreshments, Loathsom ordered his [[LEP servant droid/Legends|LEP servant droid]] to bring them something liquid, prompting the servant droid to bring a large teapot and pour them both a cup of [[Tarine tea/Legends|tarine tea]].<ref name="TCW film">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> 

A shop that specialized in ceramic teapots was located at [[Cloud Lake]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ussa]] on [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. The shop was situated on the same street as the business office of [[Roan Lands]] and [[Ferus Olin]].<ref name="Desperate Mission">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref> 

Roan's cousin [[Malory Lands]] later made [[Tea/Legends|tea]] for herself and Olin, which she served from a teapot.<ref name="Against">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Against the Empire]]''</ref> 

[[Iyon]], the [[Chamberlain/Legends|Chamberlain]] of the [[Codru-Ji]] [[Species/Legends|species]], served [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] some tea from a delicate antique stone teapot.<ref name="Crystal Star" />
